$comment: HAND-AUTHORED. The `service` block is not a component, so no factory exists for the reflector to walk and there is no vendored schema for it. Transcribed field by field from the Go source vendored into this build: go.opentelemetry.io/collector/service/config.go, service/pipelines/config.go, and service/telemetry/otelconftelemetry (config.go + internal/migration/v0.3.0.go). Only fields verified there are modelled; the two declarative-config subtrees the telemetry config squashes in (config.MeterProvider.readers/views, config.TracerProvider.processors, LogsConfig.processors) are deliberately OMITTED rather than guessed — they are otelconf v0.3.0 documents, not collector config, and nothing in this package can validate them. Their defaults (a Prometheus pull reader on :8888) apply unchanged, and `metrics.level: none` turns them off.
description: The collector's `service` block: which extensions to start, which pipelines to run, and how the collector reports on itself.

extensions.description: The ordered list of extension component ids to start. Referencing an extension that is not declared in the top-level `extensions:` section fails config validation.

pipelines.description: The data pipelines to run, keyed by pipeline id. A pipeline id is a signal, optionally followed by `/` and an instance name.

propertyNames.title: ServicePipelineId
propertyNames.$comment: BUILD POLICY — `profiles` is omitted. service/pipelines/config.go rejects a profiles pipeline unless the alpha `service.profilesSupport` feature gate is enabled, and the Lambda extension does not enable it.

additionalProperties.title: ServicePipeline
additionalProperties.description: One pipeline: the components data flows through, in order.

receivers.description: Component ids of the receivers feeding this pipeline. At least one is required.

processors.description: Component ids of the processors, applied in the order given. A processor may not appear twice in one pipeline.

exporters.description: Component ids of the exporters this pipeline fans out to. At least one is required.

telemetry.title: ServiceTelemetry
telemetry.description: The collector's own logs, metrics and traces.

logs.description: The collector's own logging. Must stay compatible with zap.Config.

development.description: Puts the logger in development mode, which changes the behavior of DPanicLevel and takes stacktraces more liberally.

disable_caller.description: Stops annotating logs with the calling function's file name and line number. By default, all logs are annotated.

disable_stacktrace.description: Completely disables automatic stacktrace capturing. By default, stacktraces are captured for WarnLevel and above logs in development and ErrorLevel and above in production.

disable_zap_resource.description: Disables adding resource attributes to logs exported through Zap. This does not affect logs exported through OTLP.

sampling.description: Sampling caps the global CPU and I/O load that logging puts on the process while attempting to preserve a representative subset of the logs.

tick.description: The interval over which each sampling decision applies.

initial.description: The first M messages logged each tick.

thereafter.description: The sampling rate: every Nth message is sampled after the initial ones each tick. Zero drops every message after the initial ones.

output_paths.description: URLs or file paths to write logging output to. `stdout` and `stderr` are interpreted as os.Stdout and os.Stderr.

error_output_paths.description: URLs or file paths to write zap's own internal logger errors to.

initial_fields.description: Fields added to the root logger.

additionalProperties.$comment: `{ type: object, additionalProperties: true }` is the reflector's — and therefore this compiler's — spelling of Go's `any`. Nesting it under an outer map is how `map[string]any` is written.

level.description: The level of telemetry metrics: `none` collects nothing, `basic` is recommended, `normal` adds indicators on top of basic, `detailed` adds dimensions and views.
Whether spans are emitted: `none` collects nothing, `basic` covers the basics of the service telemetry.

propagators.description: TextMapPropagators from the supported propagators list. `tracecontext` and `b3` are supported. Empty by default, which disables context propagation.

resource.description: User-defined attributes included with all emitted telemetry, in the legacy inline map form. Cannot be combined with the declarative `resource::attributes` list.
